clo_details: Identify relevant generative-AI techniques (LLMs, diffusion, multimodal, RAG, agents, fine-tuning, alignment) for a capstone topic.
Formulate problem statements, scope, objectives, and success criteria in a project proposal.
Plan data preparation, model selection, and licensing/ethics review.
Conduct baseline analysis using pre-trained models, prompting, and in-context learning.
Develop and adapt generative-AI systems to project requirements.
Evaluate and optimize systems using appropriate metrics and protocols, with attention to contamination and saturation.
Interpret outputs and failure modes (hallucination, bias, jailbreak) and visualize results for stakeholders.
Summarize conclusions and actionable recommendations, including deployment and cost/latency trade-offs.
Compile a final report with an explicit ethics, safety, and provenance subsection.
Deliver oral presentations with live demonstrations and Q&A defense.
